          "rawSQL": "-- One value per clearing zone for the RTM metric volume_bid_sell (template: build_dashboard.py fills\n-- volume_bid_sell, 0 and 6000 per map; Grafana fills ${...} at run time).\n--\n-- Window: the dashboard time range. \"Show\" (latest | avg | max | min) reduces it per zone.\n--   latest = each zone's own newest data point in the window (the zones may differ by a slot).\n--   \"Data as of\" = the OLDEST of those per-zone newest timestamps, i.e. how fresh the whole map is.\n-- \"Slot\" (newest | current): by default a range that ends \"now\" also includes the next one or two\n-- slots CDH already holds as cleared results; \"current\" caps the window at the present time.\n-- ts is the extractor's UTC helper (TSDB application date, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).\nWITH win AS (\n  SELECT\n    CAST(from_unixtime(${__from} / 1000) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp) AS from_ts,\n    CAST(from_unixtime(${__to} / 1000) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp) AS to_raw,\n    CAST(current_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp) AS now_ts\n), bounds AS (\n  SELECT\n    from_ts,\n    now_ts,\n    LEAST(to_raw, now_ts) AS age_ref,\n    CASE\n      WHEN ${slot:sqlstring} = 'current' THEN LEAST(to_raw, now_ts)\n      WHEN to_raw >= date_add('minute', -5, now_ts) THEN TIMESTAMP '2100-01-01 00:00:00'\n      ELSE to_raw\n    END AS to_ts\n  FROM win\n), zones(region) AS (\n  VALUES ('A1'), ('A2'), ('E1'), ('E2'), ('N1'), ('N2'), ('N3'),\n         ('S1'), ('S2'), ('S3'), ('W1'), ('W2'), ('W3')\n), ranked AS (\n  SELECT\n    region,\n    TRY_CAST(ts AS timestamp) AS delivery_time,\n    value,\n    unit,\n    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n      PARTITION BY region, ts\n      ORDER BY\n        COALESCE(\n          CAST(TRY(from_iso8601_timestamp(publication_date)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp),\n          TRY_CAST(publication_date AS timestamp)\n        ) DESC NULLS LAST,\n        COALESCE(\n          CAST(TRY(from_iso8601_timestamp(insertion_date)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp),\n          TRY_CAST(insertion_date AS timestamp)\n        ) DESC NULLS LAST,\n        COALESCE(\n          CAST(TRY(from_iso8601_timestamp(silver_insertion_date)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp),\n          TRY_CAST(silver_insertion_date AS timestamp)\n        ) DESC NULLS LAST,\n        as_of_date DESC NULLS LAST,\n        \"$path\" DESC\n    ) AS revision_rank\n  FROM india_iex_tsdb_expanded_latest\n  WHERE level = 'regional'\n    AND market = 'RTM'\n    AND metric = 'volume_bid_sell'\n    AND region IN (SELECT region FROM zones)\n    AND TRY_CAST(ts AS timestamp) IS NOT NULL\n), observations AS (\n  SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE revision_rank = 1\n), in_window AS (\n  SELECT o.* FROM observations o CROSS JOIN bounds b\n  WHERE o.value IS NOT NULL\n    AND o.delivery_time >= b.from_ts\n    AND o.delivery_time <= b.to_ts\n), per_zone AS (\n  SELECT region, MAX(delivery_time) AS latest_ts,\n         AVG(value) AS avg_v, MAX(value) AS max_v, MIN(value) AS min_v,\n         COUNT(*) AS slots, MAX(unit) AS unit\n  FROM in_window GROUP BY region\n), snapshot AS (\n  SELECT\n    z.region,\n    p.latest_ts AS delivery_time,\n    MIN(p.latest_ts) OVER () AS data_as_of,\n    CASE ${agg:sqlstring}\n      WHEN 'avg' THEN p.avg_v\n      WHEN 'max' THEN p.max_v\n      WHEN 'min' THEN p.min_v\n      ELSE l.value\n    END AS price,\n    COALESCE(l.unit, p.unit) AS unit,\n    CASE WHEN ${agg:sqlstring} IN ('avg', 'max', 'min') THEN p.slots\n         WHEN l.value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS slots,\n    CASE\n      WHEN p.latest_ts IS NULL THEN 'Missing'\n      WHEN date_diff('minute', p.latest_ts, (SELECT age_ref FROM bounds)) > 90 THEN 'Stale'\n      ELSE 'Available'\n    END AS status\n  FROM zones z\n  LEFT JOIN per_zone p ON p.region = z.region\n  LEFT JOIN in_window l ON l.region = z.region AND l.delivery_time = p.latest_ts\n), scored AS (\n  SELECT\n    snapshot.*,\n    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'Available' THEN price END) OVER () AS avg_price,\n    MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'Available' THEN price END) OVER () AS min_price,\n    MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'Available' THEN price END) OVER () AS max_price\n  FROM snapshot\n), deviation AS (\n  SELECT\n    scored.*,\n    CASE WHEN status = 'Available' AND avg_price > 0\n         THEN (price - avg_price) / avg_price * 100 END AS dev_pct\n  FROM scored\n)\n-- \"Map band\" is a colour code the dashboard maps to colours (it is not a value):\n--   0-8   level: nine equal steps between 0 and 6000 (YlOrRd, 8 = at or above 6000)\n--   10-16 deviation from the zone average (13 = within +-0.1%)\n--   20-25 position between the lowest and highest zone (20 lowest, 25 highest)\nSELECT\n  region,\n  delivery_time AS \"Delivery time\",\n  price AS \"Value\",\n  unit AS \"Unit\",\n  slots AS \"Slots\",\n  dev_pct AS \"Vs average (%)\",\n  status AS \"Status\",\n  data_as_of AS \"Data as of\",\n  CASE WHEN status = 'Available' THEN\n    CASE ${colour:sqlstring}\n      WHEN 'relative' THEN\n        CASE WHEN dev_pct IS NULL THEN NULL\n             WHEN dev_pct <= -3 THEN 10 WHEN dev_pct <= -1 THEN 11 WHEN dev_pct < -0.1 THEN 12\n             WHEN dev_pct <= 0.1 THEN 13 WHEN dev_pct < 1 THEN 14 WHEN dev_pct < 3 THEN 15\n             ELSE 16 END\n      WHEN 'range' THEN\n        CASE WHEN max_price = min_price THEN 23\n             ELSE 20 + LEAST(5, CAST(FLOOR((price - min_price) / (max_price - min_price) * 6) AS integer)) END\n      ELSE\n        CASE WHEN price <= 0 THEN 0\n             ELSE LEAST(8, CAST(FLOOR((price - 0) / (6000 - 0) * 9) AS integer)) END\n    END\n  END AS \"Map band\"\nFROM deviation\nORDER BY region\n",
          "refId": "A",
          "table": "india_iex_tsdb_expanded_latest"
        }
      ],
      "title": "RTM sell volume by clearing zone · ${agg:text}",
      "type": "geomap"
    },

to_raw,\n    CAST(current_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp) AS now_ts\n), bounds AS (\n  SELECT\n    from_ts,\n    now_ts,\n    LEAST(to_raw, now_ts) AS age_ref,\n    CASE\n      WHEN ${slot:sqlstring} = 'current' THEN LEAST(to_raw, now_ts)\n      WHEN to_raw >= date_add('minute', -5, now_ts) THEN TIMESTAMP '2100-01-01 00:00:00'\n      ELSE to_raw\n    END AS to_ts\n  FROM win\n), zones(region) AS (\n  VALUES ('A1'), ('A2'), ('E1'), ('E2'), ('N1'), ('N2'), ('N3'),\n         ('S1'), ('S2'), ('S3'), ('W1'), ('W2'), ('W3')\n), ranked AS (\n  SELECT\n    region,\n    TRY_CAST(ts AS timestamp) AS delivery_time,\n    value,\n    unit,\n    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n      PARTITION BY region, ts\n      ORDER BY\n        COALESCE(\n          CAST(TRY(from_iso8601_timestamp(publication_date)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp),\n          TRY_CAST(publication_date AS timestamp)\n        ) DESC NULLS LAST,\n        COALESCE(\n          CAST(TRY(from_iso8601_timestamp(insertion_date)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp),\n          TRY_CAST(insertion_date AS timestamp)\n        ) DESC NULLS LAST,\n        COALESCE(\n          CAST(TRY(from_iso8601_timestamp(silver_insertion_date)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp),\n          TRY_CAST(silver_insertion_date AS timestamp)\n        ) DESC NULLS LAST,\n        as_of_date DESC NULLS LAST,\n        \"$path\" DESC\n    ) AS revision_rank\n  FROM india_iex_tsdb_expanded_latest\n  WHERE level = 'regional'\n    AND market = 'RTM'\n    AND metric = 'volume_bid_purchase'\n    AND region IN (SELECT region FROM zones)\n    AND TRY_CAST(ts AS timestamp) IS NOT NULL\n), observations AS (\n  SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE revision_rank = 1\n), in_window AS (\n  SELECT o.* FROM observations o CROSS JOIN bounds b\n  WHERE o.value IS NOT NULL\n    AND o.delivery_time >= b.from_ts\n    AND o.delivery_time <= b.to_ts\n), per_zone AS (\n  SELECT region, MAX(delivery_time) AS latest_ts,\n         AVG(value) AS avg_v, MAX(value) AS max_v, MIN(value) AS min_v,\n         COUNT(*) AS slots, MAX(unit) AS unit\n  FROM in_window GROUP BY region\n), snapshot AS (\n  SELECT\n    z.region,\n    p.latest_ts AS delivery_time,\n    MIN(p.latest_ts) OVER () AS data_as_of,\n    CASE ${agg:sqlstring}\n      WHEN 'avg' THEN p.avg_v\n      WHEN 'max' THEN p.max_v\n      WHEN 'min' THEN p.min_v\n      ELSE l.value\n    END AS price,\n    COALESCE(l.unit, p.unit) AS unit,\n    CASE WHEN ${agg:sqlstring} IN ('avg', 'max', 'min') THEN p.slots\n         WHEN l.value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END AS slots,\n    CASE\n      WHEN p.latest_ts IS NULL THEN 'Missing'\n      WHEN date_diff('minute', p.latest_ts, (SELECT age_ref FROM bounds)) > 90 THEN 'Stale'\n      ELSE 'Available'\n    END AS status\n  FROM zones z\n  LEFT JOIN per_zone p ON p.region = z.region\n  LEFT JOIN in_window l ON l.region = z.region AND l.delivery_time = p.latest_ts\n), scored AS (\n  SELECT\n    snapshot.*,\n price END) OVER () AS max_price\n  FROM snapshot\n), deviation AS (\n  SELECT\n    scored.*,\n    CASE WHEN status = 'Available' AND avg_price > 0\n         THEN (price - avg_price) / avg_price * 100 END AS dev_pct\n  FROM scored\n)\n-- \"Map band\" is a colour code the dashboard maps to colours (it is not a value):\n--   0-8   level: nine equal steps between 0 and 6000 (YlOrRd, 8 = at or above ## 14:54 assistant (smp-dashboard-scr1269/dashboards/spikes)

The maps fail because Mateo copied the panels but not the dashboard variables. His export has `"templating": { "list": [] }`. The map queries use `${slot:sqlstring}`, `${agg:sqlstring}` and `${colour:sqlstring}`. With no variables defined, Grafana leaves that text in the query as written, and Athena stops at the first `$`. The error position matches: line 21, column 12 is `WHEN ${slot:sqlstring} = 'current'`, which is the first of those references in the query.

**Fix:** paste the three variables from the POC ([scr_1269_rtm_price_map.json](smp-dashboard-scr1269/dashboards/spikes/scr_1269_rtm_price_map.json)) into his dashboard JSON (Dashboard settings → JSON Model), replacing the empty `templating`:

```json
"templating": {
  "list": [
    {
      "type": "custom", "name": "agg", "label": "Show",
      "query": "Latest slot : latest, Average : avg, Maximum : max, Minimum : min",
      "current": { "text": "Latest slot", "value": "latest" },
      "multi": false, "includeAll": false, "hide": 0
    },
    {
      "type": "custom", "name": "colour", "label": "Colour by",
      "query": "Level : level, Vs zone average : relative, Spread (lowest to highest) : range",
      "current": { "text": "Level", "value": "level" },
      "multi": false, "includeAll": false, "hide": 0
    },
    {
      "type": "custom", "name": "slot", "label": "Slot",
      "query": "Newest published : newest, Current slot : current",
      "current": { "text": "Newest published", "value": "newest" },
      "multi": false, "includeAll": false, "hide": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

This also fixes the panel titles, which show `${agg:text}` as plain text right now.

Message for Mateo:

```
The maps break because the copy brought the panels but not the dashboard variables. Your JSON has "templating": {"list": []}, so ${slot}/${agg}/${colour} reach Athena as literal text, hence "mismatched input '$'". Add the 3 custom variables (agg, colour, slot) from the POC dashboard via Settings → JSON Model, or recreate them under Settings → Variables, then save. The maps should render after that.
```

I haven't tested this against his Grafana instance. Also, his three line-chart panels use a different Athena datasource UID than the map panels (`bficmsrgc0zk0c` vs `bfq7nkxjvbj0gd`). That doesn't cause this error, but it's worth checking if those charts show odd data.

## 14:56 assistant (smp-dashboard-scr1269/dashboards/spikes)

The root problem is that the panel only works if three dashboard-level variables exist, and Grafana keeps variables on the dashboard, not the panel. "Copy panel", library panels and panel JSON all leave them behind. So the fix is to make the panel work without them.

**Recommendation: make the panel self-contained, with the variables as optional extras.**

In the SQL, replace `${slot:sqlstring}` with `'${slot}'`, and do the same for `agg` and `colour`. If the variable exists, it works as it does today. If it's missing, Grafana passes the literal text `'${slot}'`, which is a valid string, so the query falls through to its `ELSE` branch. The `ELSE` branches already hold the defaults (newest / latest / level), so a pasted panel renders with sensible defaults. Adding the variables then turns on the dropdowns. One other edit: the title's `${agg:text}` would show up as plain text, so we'd drop it or move it into the description.

- **Cost:** about six small edits in the query template, plus re-publishing the POC.
- **Risk:** the sqlstring format escapes quotes, but a plain quoted variable doesn't. Someone could craft a `?var-slot=...` URL that changes the SQL. The query runs read-only in Athena, so they could only read other tables that datasource can reach. That's probably fine internally, but we should decide it on purpose.

**What I'd skip:**
- **Library panels:** they still don't bring the variables along, and you can't parameterise them per metric. The 0–6000 scale and the metric name are baked in.
- **A generator script or a custom plugin:** too much for a handful of users.

**Optional extra:** a short "Adding a zone map" note in smp-dashboard. It would cover copying the panel, changing the `metric = '...'` line and the scale, and pasting this variables snippet if they want the dropdowns.
